hints.title: Pairing Extremes
hints.text: In each tournament round, pair the highest ranked remaining competitor with the lowest ranked remaining competitor.

hints.title: Repeated Array Contraction
hints.text: Represent competitors as strings. In each pass, replace element i with the combined pair of element i and element n minus 1 minus i, then halve length.

hints.title: Iterative String Aggregation
hints.text: Initialize an array of strings from 1 to n. While the length of the active competitor list exceeds one, pair index i with index length minus 1 minus i as opening parenthesis plus left plus comma plus right plus closing parenthesis. Halve the length each round.

complexity.notes: Optimal pairing simulation constructing the tournament tree.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating and formatting strings sequentially without in-place halving requires complex recursion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Contracting an array of string representations preserves pairing order with minimal overhead.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that at each round, pair index i with index length - 1 - i until only one string remains.
